```{r Setup}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# set base folder
here::i_am("allocation_ba_round1.Rmd")

# Import utils and config
purrr::walk(
  list.files(here::here("utils"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
)

# Config
n_topics_per_student <- 2 # the number of students that shall be assigned to each topic. Leave NULL for automatic calculation that ensures every student gets at least one topic.

## Input Paths
student_preferences_ba_round1_path <- "input/student_preferences_ba_round1.txt"
topics_ba_path <- "input/topics_ba.txt"

## Output Paths
allocations_ba_round1_students_path <- "output/allocations_ba_round1_students.csv"
allocations_ba_round1_supervisors_path <- "output/allocations_ba_round1_supervisors.csv"
```

# Safely load data
```{r}
# Supervisors/Topics
topics_ba <- load_topics(topics_ba_path)

print(topics_ba)
```


```{r}
# Student preferences
student_preferences_ba_round1 <- load_student_preferences(student_preferences_ba_round1_path)

print(student_preferences_ba_round1)
```
# Check Data Validity
```{r}
# Cross validate Student and Supervisor Preferences
crossvalidate_preferences(student_preferences_ba_round1, topics_ba |> rename(supervisor_id = topic_id))
```

# Allocate Students using Global Cost Optimization
```{r}
# allocate and output student perspective
allocations_ba_round1_students <- allocate_gco(
  student_prefs = student_preferences_ba_round1,
  topic_ids = topics_ba$topic_id,
  n_topics_per_student = n_topics_per_student
  )

print(allocations_ba_round1_students)
```


```{r}
# pivot to topic perspective
allocations_ba_round1_supervisors <- pivot_to_topic_perspective(allocations_ba_round1_students)

print(allocations_ba_round1_supervisors)
```

# Write output to file

```{r}
write_csv(allocations_ba_round1_students, allocations_ba_round1_students_path)
write_csv(allocations_ba_round1_supervisors, allocations_ba_round1_supervisors_path)
```
